# WhatCode

> WhatCode is the mobile companion for OpenCode. It connects to the OpenCode AI coding agent running on your machine, so you can monitor sessions, send messages and get push notifications when an agent finishes. It is available on iPhone today, with iPad and Android planned.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://www.whatcode.app/): what WhatCode is and how it works
- [Getting Started](https://www.whatcode.app/getting-started/): connect the WhatCode mobile companion to your machine
- [WhatCode](https://www.whatcode.app/whatcode/): features of the WhatCode mobile companion
- [Screenshots](https://www.whatcode.app/screenshots/): the WhatCode mobile companion on iPhone
- [Daemon](https://www.whatcode.app/daemon/): push notifications and remote access over Tailscale
- [FAQ](https://www.whatcode.app/faq/): WhatCode mobile companion questions, supported platforms, notifications and remote access
- [Pricing](https://www.whatcode.app/pricing/): subscription plans and free trial
- [Support](https://www.whatcode.app/support/): troubleshooting
